meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 shadcn 命令行管理你项目里的 shadcn/ui 组件:查看项目配置和已装组件、在注册表里搜索、添加或更新组件、拉取组件文档与示例,并按规则写和修 UI 代码。
howto.when: 当你在 shadcn/ui 项目里涉及组件注册表、preset 代码、components.json,或要求运行 shadcn init、用 --preset 建应用等场景时,它会接管。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude manages your project's shadcn/ui components via the shadcn CLI: reading project config and installed components, searching registries, adding or updating components, fetching component docs and examples, and writing or fixing UI code by the rules.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you work in a shadcn/ui project involving component registries, preset codes, a components.json file, or when you ask to run shadcn init or create an app with --preset.
